analyzed_vuln.description: The cheap structural validator does not verify that a primitive array's values buffer (or validity bitmap) is large enough for `offset + length`; `ValidateArrayVisitor::Visit(const PrimitiveArray&)` only checks buffer count and non-null pointers. Consequently malformed IPC `ArrayData` passes `RecordBatch::Validate()`. During full validation, a nested `DictionaryArray` calls `CheckBounds` on its integer indices, and `BoundsCheckVisitor::Visit(const NumericArray<T>&)` iterates the metadata-declared length and calls `Value(i)`, reading beyond the undersized values buffer and crashing. The patch should make primitive/layout validation reject buffers smaller than the number of bits/bytes required by array offset and length before any typed access.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A crafted IPC stream supplies a structurally parseable schema/record batch containing a list whose child is a dictionary-encoded array with Int8 indices and an available dictionary, while its FieldNode declares an indices length larger than the corresponding body values buffer can hold (with entries not all skipped as null). The IPC reader propagates that metadata length and short buffer into ArrayData; cheap validation accepts the non-null buffer, list full validation recurses into the dictionary child, and dictionary bounds checking walks the declared Int8 index count until it performs an out-of-bounds read.

args: In arrow/cpp/src/arrow/array/validate.cc, what is the best API in this historical Arrow version to calculate minimum values-buffer size for a PrimitiveArray, including bit-packed BooleanArray, and where should validity bitmap size be validated? Please identify available type/layout APIs and overflow concerns.

The reported crash occurs because ValidateArrayVisitor::Visit(const PrimitiveArray&) only checks that buffers exist, while an IPC-created Int8 dictionary indices ArrayData declares length larger than its values buffer. Full dictionary bounds validation then invokes Value(i) out of bounds. I need a root-cause structural check for offset + length against values and validity buffers, preserving boolean bit packing and fixed-width primitive types. The relevant file is arrow/cpp/src/arrow/array/validate.cc; current lines 39-49 only check two buffers and pointers. Decimal128 has a separate overload. I have not patched anything yet.
